claim() calls info() to obtain deposit and reward figures.

_transfer reaches the raw token.call in TransferHelper.safeTransfer, enabling reentrancy from a malicious token.

_transfer delegates token payouts to TransferHelper.safeTransfer.

superTransfer() sets the sweep recipient to untrusted msg.sender.
superTransfer() performs external token transfers through TransferHelper.safeTransfer.
receive() asserts msg.sender equals WETH; ownership check on accepted ETH.
receive() compares the caller against the WETH state variable.
